items.title: Several killed in Russia’s ‘double-tap’ drone strike on Ukraine mall
items.description: Ukraine’s president accuses Russia of a ‘cowardly and deliberate’ attack on a mall in his hometown of Kryvyi Rih.

items.title: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says time to end war while in position of strength
items.description: 'It is better that we bring the war to an end now as we are in a position of power and dignity,' Pezeshkian said on Friday, in a meeting with doctors. His comments came after Washington announced that it would ramp up sanctions to heap pressure on the Islamic Republic.

items.title: Top Iran official says U.S. focus on economic warfare shows it has failed militarily
items.description: The Iranian regime has dismissed President Trump's threats to crush Iran economically, saying that years of U.S. sanctions have failed.

items.title: Ousted Defense Minister Calls For Elections, But Can Ukraine Hold Them During the War?
items.description: A former defense minister whose dismissal last month sparked protests has delivered a videotaped address to Ukrainians in which he assailed wartime corruption, warned of a systemic crisis of governance, and said the country must find a way to hold elections despite the continuing Russian invasion.

items.title: Why is Israel's military presence growing in Syria?
items.description: The recent Israeli attack on a Syrian airbase is just one of many Israeli incursions into Syria. In southern Syria, locals say Israeli troops have detained them, destroyed infrastructure and set up military bases.

items.title: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
